groups.activity: conservation, fishing or bounties for Ostron standing
groups.mode: Loki with Equinox's Rest subsumed, or Ivara's Sleep Arrow

rows.label: Visitor rank-up
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 25,000cr, 10 Tear Azurite, 40 Pyrol, 60 Fish Scales

conditions: Everything above counts against the daily Ostron standing cap, so this spans several days regardless of farming method.
You also need roughly 3,000-4,000 standing for parts and refinery blueprints, plus the 5,000-standing gild fee, on top of the rank-ups.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, Grip and Link blueprints

rows.label: Peye Grip Blueprint
rows.alt: Laka, Korb or Kwath for the same dagger class

conditions: Every Strike, Grip, and the base Jai/Ruhang Link sit at Neutral rank for 1,000 standing each; nothing about Balla's own build needs Visitor or Trusted.
A one-handed Grip (Peye, Laka, Korb, Kwath) makes a dagger; a two-handed Grip (Jayap, Seekalla, Kroostra, Shtung) makes a staff. Pick before forging: a built Zaw can never be taken apart.

rows.label: gild
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp + 5,000 Ostron standing, Trusted rank; resets to rank 0

rows.label: level to 30 again
rows.note: this pass is what pays Mastery

conditions: An ungilded Zaw gives zero Mastery: you have to gild it and then level it to 30 a second time.
Mastery is tied to the Strike alone; a second Balla combination earns nothing further.
Donating a rank-30 but ungilded Zaw to Hok for standing does not grant Mastery; Update 39.1 added a confirmation prompt for this.
The profanity filter blocks naming it "Balla" at the gild step.

disclosures.title: still a usable weapon
disclosures.body: Balla remains a community pick as the Exodia Contagion head for Volt; the dagger's fast dash-cancel and a stance's 200% first swing carry the arcane well. Rabvee has better Riven disposition if you're chasing the damage cap instead.
